item.title: Brown Sugar Latte Recipe
item.description: Make a brown sugar latte at home — a warm, caramel-sweet espresso drink with steamed milk and homemade brown sugar syrup. Hot and iced versions included.

item.title: Iced Brown Sugar Oatmilk Shaken Espresso: Starbucks Copycat Recipe (5 Min, 4 Pumps Syrup)
item.description: The viral Starbucks Iced Brown Sugar Oatmilk Shaken Espresso, made at home in 5 minutes — 2–3 blonde shots shaken with 4 pumps brown sugar cinnamon syrup, topped with oat milk over ice. Tastes identical for ~$0.50 vs $5.95.
